documentation.file_docstring:
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Agent OS.

Provides role assignment, policy lookup, and permission checking for agents.
member_docstrings: Role: Standard roles for agent access control.

RBACManager: Manages role-based access control for agents.

Assigns roles to agents, resolves
assign_role: Assign a role to an agent.
get_role: Return the role for an agent, defaulting to READER.
get_policy: Return the governance policy template for an agent's role.
has_permission: Check whether an agent is permitted to perform an action.
remove_role: Remove a role assignment, reverting the agent to the default role.
to_yaml: Save current role assignments and custom definitions to a YAML file.
from_yaml: Load an RBACManager from a YAML file.

classes.name: RBACManager
classes.doc:
Manages role-based access control for agents.

Assigns roles to agents, resolves governance policies per role,
and checks action permissions. Unknown agents receive the READER role.
